title: Cabin shadow cost: stationary lower commander view, then ordinary vehicle movement
input_audit: Healthy act0 training world with enemies removed. The existing gaze action and normal mouse input establish a lower commander view, held unchanged after1.2s. Ordinary drive/steer input moves the vehicle from3–6s, changing real hull/turret/source transforms. No camera teleport, shadow invalidation hook, exposure, emitter, material, weather, damage or fire override. Run with KESSEL_CAPTURE_PROFILE=1. Compare stationary frames1.5<=t<3.0 (36frames) and moving frames3.5<=t<6.0 (60frames), keeping the first render, gaze transition and initial acceleration separately visible in full telemetry.
historical_scope: Bounded renderer workload comparison, not an encounter, hardware-independent result or interactive FPS measurement.
visual_acceptance: The same source cabin remains visible while the vehicle moves; no death or station transition removes render work.
Report render-and-readback and five-tick simulation batch timings separately. Work counters must confirm moving frames actually submit the shadow work being compared.
